ADDED i22: Marking after an initial read (so the mark starts at offset 1) with a read-ahead limit beyond the bound still stops at the overall {@link #MAX_CHARS} bound.
ADDED i23: Reading lines through a {@link BufferedReader} backed by a {@link BoundedReader} must reach EOF and finish within the timeout.
ADDED i24: A bulk read requesting more than the bound returns only {@link #MAX_CHARS} characters and leaves the rest of the buffer untouched.
ADDED i25: Untouched: only 3 characters were read.
ADDED i26: A bulk read into the middle of the buffer (offset 1, length 2) fills exactly that slice and leaves the surrounding positions untouched.
ADDED i27: Before the offset: untouched.
ADDED i28: Beyond the requested length: untouched.
ADDED i29: Reading exactly {@link #MAX_CHARS} characters one at a time leaves the reader at EOF.
ADDED i30: When the underlying reader holds fewer characters than the bound, EOF comes from the exhausted underlying reader rather than from the bound.
ADDED i31: Skipped characters count toward the bound: skipping 2 then reading 1 reaches the bound, so the next read is EOF.
